Adaptation hierarchy is ORDINAL not ADDITIVE: LoRA subsumes ICL Korean-distribution benefit. Adding same-domain exemplars as context causes attention split / distraction. Mixed hurts LESS than pure Korean — consistent with exp_016 anchor-regularization (Western anchors act as 'safe diversion').
